understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete all levels by moving/click-selecting the available selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' in the semantic grid is simultaneously occupied by a selectable piece, triggering a WIN for the level and ultimately the full run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each level is a grid where positions are given in pixel coordinates (multiples of 3 per cell). Only one selectable piece is controlled at a time; you can switch control by using CLICK on the exact pixel position of another selectable. MOVE actions attempt to shift the currently selected piece one cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction; moves can be blocked by walls/boundaries or other objects. Some adjacent objects (e.g., blocks) may be pushable, moving along with the selected piece when pushed, while walls generally prevent movement; the movement_blocked flags are only hints and don’t guarantee the result.
